notes: Proved in Axeyum by a NEW kernel theorem, `Nat.dist_pos_of_ne` (`nat_prelude/dist_more2.rs`), over the ALREADY-PROVED `Nat.dist` construction (`dist.rs`, draw9-first-theorems): `Nat.dist n m := Nat.sub n m + Nat.sub m n`, the SAME definition Mathlib's `Nat.dist` states, so mirrors against it are honest under the mirror-flip criterion in CLAUDE.md. The proof case-splits `i ≠ j` into `i < j` / `j < i` (`lt_or_gt_of_ne_local`, `fermat_number_mirrors.rs`), rewrites `dist` to a `sub` via the already-proved `dist_eq_sub_of_le`/`dist_eq_sub_of_le_right`, and shows that `sub` is positive from the strict order directly (`sub_add_cancel` plus `pos_of_lt_add_left`, `fermat_number_mirrors.rs`) -- no new bitwise or induction machinery.
